description: Portable specification for one reproducible YouTube thumbnail
version: Version of this individual thumbnail specification

video.working_title: Current video title, which may be unapproved

creative.recipe: Identifier from the reusable recipe catalogue
creative.visual_metaphor: Concrete visual representation of the story
creative.reference_tile: Optional identifier of the approved visual reference

presenter.file_id: Optional exact external asset identifier or null
presenter.visible: Boolean indicating whether the presenter appears
presenter.gesture_status: Available, missing or requires reviewed variation
presenter.framing: Close-up, medium close-up or another camera framing

required.source: External asset path or library reference

optional: Additional useful asset identifiers or descriptions

asset_requirements.use_authentic_assets: Whether authentic source assets are mandatory
asset_requirements.allow_illustrative_assets: Whether conceptual graphics may be generated
asset_requirements.missing_asset_policy: What to do when an asset cannot be resolved

composition.background: Description of the background and its visual treatment
graphics: List of visual graphics and annotations

rendering.mode: Generation, compositing or hybrid rendering strategy

generation_record._note: Written once per generated image, AFTER generation; not part of the creative spec. Consumed by FliStudio as the `meta` of a thumbnail resource (ref.schema = "thumbnail.generation"). Selection status (candidate / in YouTube test / chosen) is deliberately NOT here: FliStudio owns it.
generation_record.thumbnail_id: Spec id + run number, e.g. d03.a1.r1
generation_record.spec_ref: Path of the spec relative to this folder, e.g. specs/d03-a1-detection-overlay.json
generation_record.spec_sha: Git blob sha of the spec file at generation time

presenter.file_id: Portrait file id (authoritative; use this, not the path)
presenter.resolved_path: Snapshot of where the file was read from; informational only

generation_record.reference_assets: Array of {id, file_id} for every attached asset

generation.model: Model name as reported by the tool
generation.seed: Seed if the tool exposes one, else null
generation.conversation_id: Chat id when generated in a chat (must be a fresh chat for repeatability)
generation.gen_id: Tool's generation id from image metadata (provenance only)

files.background: Path to the image before the text layer
